label: Foundation — Week 1
note: Week 1 is about finding the rhythm of the new week structure. Your Tuesday commute (66km round trip) is already a serious aerobic session on its own — everything else is built around recovering from it, not adding to it.

Mon.title: Rest / easy walk
Mon.detail: Lunchtime off — walk if you like, or just eat properly.

Tue_am.title: Commute out — steady
Tue_am.detail: Save the legs for the interval work on the way home.

Tue_pm.title: Commute home — intervals
Tue_pm.detail: No power meter needed — go by feel. First one back, see how it feels.

Thu_lunch.detail: Easy continuous run, finished with strides to open the legs up.

Thu_eve.detail: Drills into a steady aerobic set.

Fri.detail: Save the legs for tomorrow's parkrun — a short stretch if you fancy it, otherwise switch off completely.

Sat.detail: Parkrun eases you in, then extend it.

Sat_eve.title: S&C — Lower-body strength
Sat_eve.detail: 3 rounds: goblet squat x12, single-leg RDL x8/side, calf raises x15, glute bridge x12. Any time today works — straight after parkrun, or later if that fits better.

Sun.title: Ride — easy
Sun.detail: Kept short — the commute is doing the heavy lifting this week.

Tue_am.detail: Save the legs for the interval work on the way home.
